name: kairon
description: Find B2B leads, define your ideal customer, judge who fits, build and run campaigns, and follow replies in your Kairon workspace.

interface.longDescription: Kairon helps B2B teams find the right people, judge who fits, build a campaign and follow the replies, from ChatGPT. Search for professionals and companies by title, seniority, location, industry, company size or keywords, or look in your own network. Read a lead's profile and what they have posted. Save the people you choose to lists that also show in the Kairon web app. Say who you sell to and Kairon keeps it as an ideal customer profile you review before it goes live. Kairon then judges which people in a list fit it, one batch at a time, and shows why for each person. Find work emails and mobiles for the leads that fit. Build a campaign from a template, read the messages it would send, publish it and turn it on. Review the messages a campaign wrote and approve or skip them, one at a time. Send one message or one connection invitation to one person. Change one step of a campaign, see where one person is in it and why, and take people out of it. Search posts by the words in them. Mark by hand who fits. Keep people and companies out of your outreach, move leads along your pipeline, and read how your outreach is doing. Every send reaches one real person, and ChatGPT asks for your yes to each one. There is no tool that sends to a whole list. Judging leads and finding emails or mobiles use your workspace balance, and each tool says so in its description. You sign in with your Kairon account and see only your own workspace.
capabilities: Send a message or invitation to one person
defaultPrompt: Find 25 heads of sales at fintech companies in Mexico and save them in a new list called "Fintech MX – Heads of sales".
Using Kairon, save this as my ideal customer profile: I sell payroll software to HR heads at mid-size companies in Chile.
How are my campaigns doing, and which conversations are still waiting for my answer?

positive.description: Create a list and save chosen people
positive.prompt: Using Kairon, find heads of sales at fintech companies in Mexico, then create a list called Fintech MX and save the first five people to it.
positive.expected_behavior: people_search finds the people. list_create makes the list, then list_add_leads saves five of them. It reports five added and gives a link to the list in the Kairon web app.

positive.description: Say who you sell to and save it as an ideal customer draft
positive.prompt: Using Kairon, save this as my ideal customer profile: I sell payroll software to HR heads at mid-size companies in Chile.
positive.expected_behavior: icp_create makes a draft ideal customer profile from the filters and short yes/no checks ChatGPT writes. It is a draft: nothing uses it yet. ChatGPT shows the filters and checks in plain words. icp_publish makes it live, and ChatGPT asks for permission before it runs.

positive.description: Judge the first batch of a list against the ideal customer (run after cases 1 and 2, with the ideal customer made live)
positive.prompt: Using Kairon, judge the first batch of my Fintech MX list against my ideal customer.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT finds the live ideal customer and the list, then list_qualify judges the first batch (up to 20 people). It reports how many fit and what the misses have in common, and offers to judge more.

positive.description: See how campaigns are doing and who is waiting
positive.prompt: Using Kairon, how are my campaigns doing? Show me the one with the most replies and who is still waiting for the next step.
positive.expected_behavior: campaign_search lists the campaigns. campaign_stats returns the counts for one: people reached, replies and people still waiting. campaign_runs lists the people in it with the step each one is on. Nothing is sent or changed.

positive.prompt: Using Kairon, which conversations have I not answered yet? Show who is responsible for each one.
positive.expected_behavior: conversation_search returns the conversations still unanswered, each with the person, the teammate responsible and a short extract of the last message.

positive.description: Build a campaign from a template
positive.prompt: Using Kairon, build a campaign from a template for my Fintech MX list, show me the flow and the first messages, then publish it.
positive.expected_behavior: sender_search finds the connected sender and campaign_template_search lists the templates. campaign_create makes a draft with the chosen template, the list and the sender. campaign_preview shows the first messages. ChatGPT asks for permission before campaign_publish runs. The campaign is not turned on, and nothing is sent.

positive.description: Approve one draft waiting for review
positive.prompt: Using Kairon, show me the drafts waiting for my review and approve the one for Sofía Granger.
positive.expected_behavior: review_search lists the drafts waiting for review with the person and the words. After the person says yes to that one draft, review_approve approves it and that one message goes out. No other draft is approved.

positive.description: Send one message to one person after a yes
positive.prompt: Using Kairon, send Lucía Ferrer a short message asking if she is hiring sales reps in Mexico.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT shows the exact words and the name, and asks for a yes. After the yes, message_send sends that one message to that one person and reports it as sent.

positive.description: See where one person is in a campaign, then take them out
positive.prompt: Using Kairon, show me where Sofía Granger is in my Heads of sales MX campaign and what we sent her, then stop her sequence.
positive.expected_behavior: campaign_runs finds Sofía Granger in that campaign and campaign_person_get shows each step and the messages sent to her. After the person says yes, campaign_person_remove stops her in that campaign only and reports her as removed. Nobody else is stopped.

positive.description: Tag one person and set a reminder about them
positive.prompt: Using Kairon, tag Sofía Granger from my Heads of sales MX list as warm, and remind me to call her next Monday.
positive.expected_behavior: list_leads finds Sofía Granger on that list. tag_search shows the warm tag exists, lead_tags_set sets her tags to keep the ones she has and add warm, and task_save creates one task about her due next Monday. Nobody is messaged.

negative.description: Unsupported: sending to a whole list. No Kairon tool sends to many people at once, so nothing is sent.
negative.prompt: Send a message to everyone in my Fintech MX list.

negative.description: Unsupported: deleting a list. No Kairon tool deletes a list, so the list stays.
Off topic. No Kairon tool is called.
negative.prompt: What is the weather in Buenos Aires today?

publication.release_notes: Adds changing one step of a campaign, seeing where one person is in a campaign, starting one person in it and taking people out, adding a sender to a campaign and setting its daily limit, and running a list's source to keep it growing. Adds more search filters, searching posts by their words, marking by hand who fits, tags and reminders on a lead, and how your workspace writes its messages. Setup now starts with a sending account, then what you sell and who you sell to, before any list. There is no tool that sends to a whole list.
